source.bookSourceComment: 一流小说网 www.yi16.com 书源（GBK 站点，杰奇魔改）。正文与目录都用 CSS 伪元素隐写：真实文字在页面内嵌 <style> 里（正文 #htmlContent .p_N::after、目录 .p_{cid}::after），页面上 span 全为空、目录 dd 的 title 属性是错位假名，故正文/目录规则走 JS 解析 style 映射。目录分页 /yi16book/{aid}_{page}/（每页60章），章节分页 {cid}_2.html。搜索 searchkey 必须 GBK 编码（UTF-8 编码返回0结果），单结果 302 直达书页已兼容。创建于2026-10-18。

ruleContent.content:
<js>var BASE = 'https://www.yi16.com';
function unesc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/\\A\s?/g, '\n').replace(/\\'/g, "'").replace(/\\\\/g, '\\');
}
function extract(h) {
    var re = /#htmlContent\s+\.p_(\d+)::after\s*\{\s*content:'((?:[^'\\]|\\.)*)'\s*\}/g;
    var map = {};
    var m;
    while ((m = re.exec(h)) !== null) {
        map[String(m[1])] = String(m[2]);
    }
    var idx = [];
    for (var k in map) {
        idx.push(parseInt(k, 10));
    }
    idx.sort(function (x, y) { return x - y; });
    var ps = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) {
        var s = unesc(map[idx[i]]);
        if (s.replace(/\s/g, '').length > 0) ps.push(s);
    }
    return ps.join('\n');
}
var cur = String(baseUrl);
var parts = [];
var guard = 0;
while (cur && guard < 6) {
    var h = '';
    try {
        h = String(java.ajax(cur + ',{"headers":{"Referer":"' + BASE + '/"}}'));
    } catch (e) {
        break;
    }
    var t = extract(h);
    if (t.length > 0) parts.push(t);
    var m = h.match(/id="linkNext"[^>]*href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/);
    if (!m) break;
    if (String(m[2]).indexOf('下一页') < 0) break;
    var nxt = String(m[1]);
    if (nxt.indexOf('http') === 0) {
        cur = nxt;
    } else if (nxt.charAt(0) === '/') {
        cur = BASE + nxt;
    } else {
        cur = cur.substring(0, cur.lastIndexOf('/') + 1) + nxt;
    }
    guard++;
}
var out = parts.join('\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
out;</js>

<js>var html = String(result || '');
if (html.indexOf('list-chapterAll') < 0) {
    try {
        html = String(java.ajax(String(baseUrl)));
    } catch (e) {
    }
}
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html, String(baseUrl));
function unesc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/\\A\s?/g, '\n').replace(/\\'/g, "'").replace(/\\\\/g, '\\');
}
var names = {};
var re = /\.p_(\d+)::after\s*\{\s*content:'((?:[^'\\]|\\.)*)'\s*\}/g;
var m;
while ((m = re.exec(html)) !== null) {
    names[String(m[1])] = String(m[2]);
}
var pageNo = 1;
var pm = String(baseUrl).match(/yi16book\/\d+_(\d+)\/?$/);
if (pm) pageNo = parseInt(pm[1], 10);
var as = doc.select('#list-chapterAll dd a');
for (var i = as.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    var a = as.get(i);
    var href = String(a.attr('href'));
    var mm = href.match(/\/(\d+)\.html/);
    if (!mm) {
        a.remove();
        continue;
    }
    var cid = String(mm[1]);
    var nm = names[cid];
    if (nm === undefined) {
        nm = '第' + ((pageNo - 1) * 60 + i + 1) + '章';
    } else {
        nm = unesc(nm);
        if (!nm) nm = '第' + ((pageNo - 1) * 60 + i + 1) + '章';
    }
    a.text(nm);
    a.attr('href', a.absUrl('href'));
}
doc.select('#list-chapterAll dd a');</js>

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {
    for (var i in param) {
      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);

};

ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
(function () {
    var g = function (r) {
        try { return String(java.getString(r) || '').trim(); } catch (e) { return ''; }
    };
    var uniq = function (v, i, a) { return v && a.indexOf(v) == i; };

    var words = parseInt(g('$.words_num')) || 0;
    var ws = words >= 10000 ? (words / 10000).toFixed(1) + '万字' : (words ? words + '字' : '');
    var chapters = g('$.chapters');
    var state = [ws, g('$.is_over') == '1' ? '已完结' : '连载中', chapters ? '共' + chapters + '章' : ''].filter(uniq).join(' · ');

    var ts = parseInt(g('$.update_time')) || 0;
    var time = ts ? String(java.timeFormat(ts * 1000)).replace(/\//g, '-') : '';

    var cat = [g('$.category1_name'), g('$.category2_name')].filter(uniq).join(' · ');
    var tags = g('$.book_tag_list[*].title').split(/\s*\n\s*/).filter(uniq).join(' · ');

    var score = g('$.attribute.score');
    var scoreT = g('$.attribute.score_title');
    var info = g('$.attribute.reading_info_list[*]').split(/\s*\n\s*/);
    var hot = [];
    if (info[0]) hot.push(info[0] + (info[1] ? '（' + info[1].split('・').pop() + '）' : ''));
    if (info[2]) hot.push(info[2] + '人在读');

    var desc = g('$.intro')
        .replace(/\r/g, '')
        .replace(/^[\s\u3000]+/, '')
        .replace(/[ \t\u3000]*\n[\s\u3000]*/g, '\n')
        .replace(/\n/g, '\n\u3000\u3000');

    var L = [];
    var add = function (icon, label, val) {
        if (val) L.push('\u3000\u3000' + icon + ' ' + label + '：' + val);
    };
    add('📕', '书名', g('$.title'));
    add('👤', '作者', g('$.author'));
    add('🗂️', '分类', cat);
    add('📊', '字数', state);
    add('🔖', '标签', tags);
    add('⭐', '评分', score ? score + (scoreT ? '（' + scoreT + '）' : '') : '');
    add('🔥', '人气', hot.join(' · '));
    add('🕐', '更新', time);
    add('📖', '最新', g('$.latest_chapter_title'));
    if (desc) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📜 简介：');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000' + desc);
    }
    var src = g('$.source');
    if (src) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📍 版权来源：' + src);
    }
    return L.join('\n');
})()
</js>

<js>
(function () {
    var g = function (r) {
        try { return String(java.getString(r) || '').trim(); } catch (e) { return ''; }
    };
    var uniq = function (v, i, a) { return v && a.indexOf(v) == i; };

    var words = parseInt(g('$.words_num')) || 0;
    var ws = words >= 10000 ? (words / 10000).toFixed(1) + '万字' : (words ? words + '字' : '');
    var chapters = g('$.chapters');
    var state = [ws, g('$.is_over') == '1' ? '已完结' : '连载中', chapters ? '共' + chapters + '章' : ''].filter(uniq).join(' · ');

    var ts = parseInt(g('$.update_time')) || 0;
    var time = ts ? String(java.timeFormat(ts * 1000)).replace(/\//g, '-') : '';

    var cat = [g('$.category1_name'), g('$.category2_name')].filter(uniq).join(' · ');
    var tags = g('$.book_tag_list[*].title').split(/\s*\n\s*/).filter(uniq).join(' · ');

    var score = g('$.attribute.score');
    var scoreT = g('$.attribute.score_title');
    var info = g('$.attribute.reading_info_list[*]').split(/\s*\n\s*/);
    var hot = [];
    if (info[0]) hot.push(info[0] + (info[1] ? '（' + info[1].split('・').pop() + '）' : ''));
    if (info[2]) hot.push(info[2] + '人在读');

    var desc = g('$.intro')
        .replace(/\r/g, '')
        .replace(/^[\s\u3000]+/, '')
        .replace(/[ \t\u3000]*\n[\s\u3000]*/g, '\n')
        .replace(/\n/g, '\n\u3000\u3000');

    var L = [];
    var add = function (icon, label, val) {
        if (val) L.push('\u3000\u3000' + icon + ' ' + label + '：' + val);
    };
    add('📕', '书名', g('$.title'));
    add('👤', '作者', g('$.author'));
    add('🗂️', '分类', cat);
    add('📊', '字数', state);
    add('🔖', '标签', tags);
    add('⭐', '评分', score ? score + (scoreT ? '（' + scoreT + '）' : '') : '');
    add('🔥', '人气', hot.join(' · '));
    add('🕐', '更新', time);
    add('📖', '最新', g('$.latest_chapter_title'));
    if (desc) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📜 简介：');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000' + desc);
    }
    var src = g('$.source');
    if (src) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📍 版权来源：' + src);
    }
    return L.join('\n');
})()
</js>

ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
(function () {
    var g = function (r) {
        try { return String(java.getString(r) || '').trim(); } catch (e) { return ''; }
    };
    var uniq = function (v, i, a) { return v && a.indexOf(v) == i; };

    var words = parseInt(g('$.words_num')) || 0;
    var ws = words >= 10000 ? (words / 10000).toFixed(1) + '万字' : (words ? words + '字' : '');
    var chapters = g('$.chapters');
    var state = [ws, g('$.is_over') == '1' ? '已完结' : '连载中', chapters ? '共' + chapters + '章' : ''].filter(uniq).join(' · ');

    var ts = parseInt(g('$.update_time')) || 0;
    var time = ts ? String(java.timeFormat(ts * 1000)).replace(/\//g, '-') : '';

    var cat = [g('$.category1_name'), g('$.category2_name')].filter(uniq).join(' · ');
    var tags = g('$.book_tag_list[*].title').split(/\s*\n\s*/).filter(uniq).join(' · ');

    var score = g('$.attribute.score');
    var scoreT = g('$.attribute.score_title');
    var info = g('$.attribute.reading_info_list[*]').split(/\s*\n\s*/);
    var hot = [];
    if (info[0]) hot.push(info[0] + (info[1] ? '（' + info[1].split('・').pop() + '）' : ''));
    if (info[2]) hot.push(info[2] + '人在读');

    var desc = g('$.intro')
        .replace(/\r/g, '')
        .replace(/^[\s\u3000]+/, '')
        .replace(/[ \t\u3000]*\n[\s\u3000]*/g, '\n')
        .replace(/\n/g, '\n\u3000\u3000');

    var L = [];
    var add = function (icon, label, val) {
        if (val) L.push('\u3000\u3000' + icon + ' ' + label + '：' + val);
    };
    add('📕', '书名', g('$.title'));
    add('👤', '作者', g('$.author'));
    add('🗂️', '分类', cat);
    add('📊', '字数', state);
    add('🔖', '标签', tags);
    add('⭐', '评分', score ? score + (scoreT ? '（' + scoreT + '）' : '') : '');
    add('🔥', '人气', hot.join(' · '));
    add('🕐', '更新', time);
    add('📖', '最新', g('$.latest_chapter_title'));
    if (desc) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📜 简介：');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000' + desc);
    }
    var src = g('$.source');
    if (src) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📍 版权来源：' + src);
    }
    return L.join('\n');
})()
</js>

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {
    for (var i in param) {
      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);
      paramStr += urlEncode(param[i], k, encode);
    }
  }
  return paramStr;
};

var category = function () {
  params={'gender':gender,'category_id':category_id,'need_filters':need_filters,'page':page,'need_category':need_category}

};

};

  category()

ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
(function () {
    var g = function (r) {
        try { return String(java.getString(r) || '').trim(); } catch (e) { return ''; }
    };
    var uniq = function (v, i, a) { return v && a.indexOf(v) == i; };

    var words = parseInt(g('$.words_num')) || 0;
    var ws = words >= 10000 ? (words / 10000).toFixed(1) + '万字' : (words ? words + '字' : '');
    var chapters = g('$.chapters');
    var state = [ws, g('$.is_over') == '1' ? '已完结' : '连载中', chapters ? '共' + chapters + '章' : ''].filter(uniq).join(' · ');

    var ts = parseInt(g('$.update_time')) || 0;
    var time = ts ? String(java.timeFormat(ts * 1000)).replace(/\//g, '-') : '';

    var cat = [g('$.category1_name'), g('$.category2_name')].filter(uniq).join(' · ');
    var tags = g('$.book_tag_list[*].title').split(/\s*\n\s*/).filter(uniq).join(' · ');

    var score = g('$.attribute.score');
    var scoreT = g('$.attribute.score_title');
    var info = g('$.attribute.reading_info_list[*]').split(/\s*\n\s*/);
    var hot = [];
    if (info[0]) hot.push(info[0] + (info[1] ? '（' + info[1].split('・').pop() + '）' : ''));
    if (info[2]) hot.push(info[2] + '人在读');

    var desc = g('$.intro')
        .replace(/\r/g, '')
        .replace(/^[\s\u3000]+/, '')
        .replace(/[ \t\u3000]*\n[\s\u3000]*/g, '\n')
        .replace(/\n/g, '\n\u3000\u3000');

    var L = [];
    var add = function (icon, label, val) {
        if (val) L.push('\u3000\u3000' + icon + ' ' + label + '：' + val);
    };
    add('📕', '书名', g('$.title'));
    add('👤', '作者', g('$.author'));
    add('🗂️', '分类', cat);
    add('📊', '字数', state);
    add('🔖', '标签', tags);
    add('⭐', '评分', score ? score + (scoreT ? '（' + scoreT + '）' : '') : '');
    add('🔥', '人气', hot.join(' · '));
    add('🕐', '更新', time);
    add('📖', '最新', g('$.latest_chapter_title'));
    if (desc) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📜 简介：');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000' + desc);
    }
    var src = g('$.source');
    if (src) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📍 版权来源：' + src);
    }
    return L.join('\n');
})()
</js>

var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);

	name: og('novel:book_name').replace(/(全文|小说|免费阅读|最新章节).*|[(（].*[）)]/g, ''),

	cover: og('image'),
url:og('novel:read_url'),
};
